name: EvilEye-TS-TW
title: Evil Eye
description: A wide ellipse of orange flame draws a single eye on black, with fibrous rays around a dark vertical slit. The flame ripples and the pupil slides toward the pointer.
use: A dark fantasy or horror page needs a single menacing focal graphic.
avoid: You need something friendly or brand-neutral: the orange fire and slit pupil are strongly sinister.
a11y: Decorative canvas with no text alternative and no reduced-motion check for the constant flame motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A stretched horizontal eye shape built from hundreds of fine orange and amber filaments, brightest in a ring around the middle. The pupil is a narrow black slit at the centre, and the edges break into ragged tongues of fire.
behaves: The filament ring churns and flares continuously like fire. As the pointer moves, the pupil drifts toward it and settles back to the middle when the pointer leaves.
customise: Eye colour, intensity, pupil size, iris width, glow, scale, noise, pupil follow, flame speed and background colour are props. The eye's shape is fixed in the shader.
weight: heavy: A full-screen shader samples a generated noise texture every frame.
